900.3.10(1402).explanation: Exception RD 1402: a pre-1953 detached house on a lot with a 0.6 FSI may get a rear addition up to 0.69 FSI, subject to floor-level, side-wall and prior-addition-age conditions; raised platforms may not encroach into required front or rear yards; lots with 7.6 m frontage or less may not have a vehicle entrance through the front wall; parts of former Toronto By-law 438-86 and by-law 75-80 (33-35 Chaplin Cres) also prevail.

900.3.10(464).explanation: Exception RD 464: buildings must be 22.0 m from the original centreline of Galloway, Morningside, Manse, Beechgrove, Old Kingston and Lawrence; corner lots need 15.0 m frontage; side setbacks are 1.2 m (5.7 m on a street side) and garages 0.3 m from an interior side lot line; exception 1462 also applies, and a former Scarborough exception prevails at 102 and 102A Poplar Rd.

900.3.10(102).explanation: Exception RD 102: the minimum lot frontage and lot area are those existing when the by-law was enacted; buildings must be 22.0 m from the original centreline of Scarborough Golf Club Rd. and Orton Park Rd.; side setbacks are 1.2 m (4.5 m on a street side) and garages 0.3 m from a side lot line.
